generate_speech_from_text: generate speech waveform from text input using SpeechT5ForTextToSpeech model with speaker embeddings
transcribe_speech_to_text: transcribe audio waveform to text using SpeechT5ForSpeechToText model with encoder and text decoder
convert_speech_to_speech: convert speech waveform to target speaker speech using SpeechT5ForSpeechToSpeech model with speaker embeddings
run_encoder_decoder_forward: run bidirectional encoder-decoder forward pass using SpeechT5Model with optional prenet wrappers
synthesize_waveform_from_spectrogram: synthesize speech waveform from log-mel spectrogram using SpeechT5HifiGan vocoder
